d:
This Diwali, meet the potters of Uttam Nagar’s Potters Village in Delhi, whose traditional art and livelihood face growing challenges amid pollution concerns and changing market conditions. In this ground report, we explore the struggles of pottery artisans, the future of mitti ke diye (earthen diyas), and the challenges of preserving a centuries-old craft.
Watch this special Diwali Ground Report on Delhi’s potters and their fight to preserve traditional craftsmanship.
Report by: Nilanjay Tiwari
